```{r }
#Installing and activate the packages
#install.packages("tidyverse")
#install.packages("ggplot2")
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r }
#Civic Status 1801 Visualisation bar chart
Census1801 <- read_csv("data/Census_1801.csv")
glimpse(Census1801)

Census1801 <- Census1801 %>%
  mutate(
    civilstand = str_trim(str_to_lower(civilstand)),
    civilstand = if_else(is.na(civilstand), "blank", civilstand))

count(Census1801, civilstand)

civilstand_counts_1801 <- Census1801 %>%
  count(civilstand)

bar_1801 <- ggplot(civilstand_counts_1801,
                   aes(x = civilstand, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.3) +
  labs(
    title = "Civil Status Distribution (Census 1801)",
    x = "Civil status",
    y = "Number of individuals")

bar_1801

#Civic Status 1801 visualisation in percentages
civilstand_percent_1801 <- civilstand_counts_1801 %>%
  filter(civilstand != "blank") %>%   # ✅ FIX 3: remove blank ONLY for percentages
  mutate(
    percent = n / sum(n),
    label = scales::percent(percent, accuracy = 0.1))

percentage_pie_1801 <- ggplot(civilstand_percent_1801,
  aes(x = "", y = percent, fill = civilstand)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Civil Status Distribution (Census 1801)",
    fill = "Civil status") +
  theme_void()

percentage_pie_1801

```

```{r }
#Civic Status 1834 Visualisation bar chart
Census1834 <- read_csv("data/Census_1834.csv")
glimpse(Census1834)

Census1834 <- Census1834 %>%
  mutate(
    civilstand = str_trim(str_to_lower(civilstand)),
    civilstand = if_else(is.na(civilstand), "blank", civilstand))

civilstand_counts_1834 <- Census1834 %>%
  count(civilstand)

bar_1834 <- ggplot(civilstand_counts_1834,
  aes(x = civilstand, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.3) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    title = "Civil Status Distribution (Census 1834)",
    x = "Civil status",
    y = "Number of individuals")

bar_1834

#Civic Status 1834 Visualisation in percentages
civilstand_percent_1834 <- civilstand_counts_1834 %>%
  filter(civilstand != "blank") %>%   # ✅ FIX 3 again
  mutate(
    percent = n / sum(n),
    label = scales::percent(percent, accuracy = 0.01)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(percent))

civilstand_percent_1834 <- civilstand_percent_1834 %>%
  mutate(
    legend_label = paste0(civilstand, " (", label, ")"))

percentage_pie_1834 <- ggplot(civilstand_percent_1834,
  aes(x = "", y = percent, fill = legend_label)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  labs(
    title = "Civil Status Distribution (Census 1834)",
    fill = "Civil status") +
  theme_void()

percentage_pie_1834

```


```{r }
#Civic Status 1860 Visualisation bar chart
Census1860 <- read_csv("data/Census_1860.csv")
  glimpse(Census1860)

Census1860 <- Census1860 %>%
  mutate(
    civilstand = str_trim(str_to_lower(civilstand)),
    civilstand = if_else(is.na(civilstand), "blank", civilstand),
    civilstand = recode(civilstand, "enkemand" = "enke")  )

civilstand_counts_1860 <- Census1860 %>%
  count(civilstand)

bar_1860 <- ggplot(civilstand_counts_1860,
  aes(x = civilstand, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.3) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    title = "Civil Status Distribution (Census 1860)",
    x = "Civil status",
    y = "Number of individuals")

bar_1860

#Civic Status 1860 Visualisation in percentages
civilstand_percent_1860 <- civilstand_counts_1860 %>%
  filter(civilstand != "blank") %>%   # ✅ FIX 3 again
  mutate(
    percent = n / sum(n),
    label = scales::percent(percent, accuracy = 0.01)) %>%
  arrange(desc(percent))

civilstand_percent_1860 <- civilstand_percent_1860 %>%
  mutate(
    legend_label = paste0(civilstand, " (", label, ")"))

percentage_pie_1860 <- ggplot(civilstand_percent_1860,
  aes(x = "", y = percent, fill = legend_label)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  labs(
    title = "Civil Status Distribution (Census 1860)",
    fill = "Civil status"
  ) +
  theme_void()

percentage_pie_1860

```

```{r }
#Comparing the 3 censuses
civilstand_percent_1801 <- Census1801 %>%
  filter(!is.na(civilstand)) %>%
  count(civilstand) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n), year = "1801")

civilstand_percent_1834 <- Census1834 %>%
  filter(!is.na(civilstand)) %>%
  count(civilstand) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n), year = "1834")

civilstand_percent_1860 <- Census1860 %>%
  filter(!is.na(civilstand)) %>%
  count(civilstand) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n), year = "1860")

#Combining and plotting the censuses across years 
civilstand_all <- bind_rows(
  civilstand_percent_1801,
  civilstand_percent_1834,
  civilstand_percent_1860) %>%
  mutate(
    civilstand = factor(civilstand, levels = c("ugift", "gift", "enke", "skilt")),
    year = factor(year, levels = c("1801", "1834", "1860"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(civilstand))

Comparisons <- ggplot(civilstand_all,
  aes(x = civilstand, y = percent, fill = year)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(percent * 100, 2), "%")),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3,
    fontface = "bold") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(x * 100, 2), "%")) +
  expand_limits(y = max(civilstand_all$percent) + 0.05) +
  labs(
    title = "Civil Status Distribution (1801–1860)",
    x = "Civil status",
    y = "Percentage",
    fill = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()

Comparisons
```
